notes: Charm designs set units the way Charm does: new Sensors, Battery, FPS and Weather designs start each reading at Charm's value column with its unit riding right after the digits (“54 °C”, “6.2 mph”), instead of the unit sitting in a column…

A unit that rides after its number uses its portal's own spacing: Charm's 2px column gap, Omen's 0.03 of the number's size. Mirage's readings carry their unit inside the value, so nothing changes there.
